Grants <pve 90% /> <pvp [58%] /> Damage Resistance. Lasts 25 seconds at base, draining 4% Super Energy per second.

Light Attacks consume 6% Super Energy, deal <pve 499 /> <pvp [?] /> damage, and heavily knock enemies back. Landing a Light Attack causes the next Heavy Attack hit to deal <pve 273 /> <pvp [?] /> damage 4 additional times.

Heavy Attacks consume 12% Super Energy to slam downwards, dealing <pve 1619 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and <arc Blinding /> enemies in an 11 meter radius. Each slam creates up to 4 aftershocks, each dealing up to <pve 292 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.

Casting the Super also performs a slam, without the aftershocks.
